{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
deduplicated = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm only
treatment_only = deduplicated[deduplicated['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction of responders
fraction_responded = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

# Print the exact numbers we will report
print(len(treatment_only))
print(treatment_only['responded'].sum())
print(fraction_responded)"}
